name: 1inch FusionV1 Settlement
fix_description: At line 118 in _settleOrder, bounds checking after calldataload uses unsigned comparison (gt/lt opcodes). When interactionLength overflows via crafted oversized calldata, the value wraps to a large positive number that passes unsigned checks. This corrupts the suffix offset, allowing attacker to inject a forged resolver address. Fix: replace gt/lt with sgt/slt (signed comparison) so overflow values are interpreted as negative and fail bounds checks. Also add explicit overflow guard: if gt(length, 0x7FFF...F) { revert }.
